captions.detailed: This 3D model is a custom cylindrical spool adapter plug. It consists of a wider base flange and a narrower concentric upper cylinder, designed to fit snugly inside a filament spool hub. A small central guide hole runs completely through the vertical axis of the part to accommodate a thin spool holder rod.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric filament spool adapter plug in OpenSCAD. The plug must feature a wider base flange, a main insertion cylinder sized to fit a spool inner diameter, and a small central through-hole for a mounting rod.
captions.factory: The design uses a union of two cylinder primitives to form the outer body: a wider, flat cylinder for the base flange and a taller, narrower cylinder for the main plug diameter. A difference boolean operation is then performed to subtract a central hole using a third cylinder, and a custom text label is embossed onto the top surface of the base flange using the external writecylinder module.
